name: Nem nuong
summary: Nem nướng is a night snack on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở, eaten as walking food. It is a different plate from nem chợ huyện.
origin: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở, Quy Nhon.
howToEat: Eat it as walking food at night.
where: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. Numbers 185–187 Phan Bội Châu are the tourism office, not a stall.
seoTitle: Nem nuong — a Quy Nhon night snack
seoDescription: Nem nướng is a Quy Nhon night snack on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở, eaten as walking food.
